messages:
pagerduty: PAGED: runtime latency spike detected in us-west-2 after recent rollout. 95th latency ~3x, error rate ~1.2%. Paged: @Jordan (SRE) @Emily (oncall)

deploy-bot: Deploy rdo_6270001 rolled to us-west-2 canary (20% traffic) at 2026-03-17T22:04:12Z. Related PR: https://git.internal/r/8723.

Jordan (SRE): I'm digging in. Initial glance: microbatch tail latencies exploded, a lot of kernel selector fallbacks to reference path on canary nodes.

Matt (Runtime): Confirming from node logs: kernel_select: heuristic chosen -> new_selector_v2; then failing to find optimized kernel, falling back: "kernel_fallback: cpu_emu". Also see batching queue starve messages.

Emily (oncall): Thanks. Can we flip the adaptive-batching feature flag off for us-west-2 to isolate? That was part of the release. @Alex any objections?

Alex (Releases): No objections. Prefer kill-switch before full rollback to avoid global churn. If flip doesn't help, we'll revert rdo_6270001.

Jordan (SRE): I'm going to flip the kill-switch and watch. Command: `curl -s -XPOST https://flags.internal/api/flip -d '{"flag":"adaptive-batching","env":"us-west-2","state":"off"}'`

oncall-bot: REQUEST: flip adaptive-batching -> off (us-west-2). Actioned by Jordan (SRE).

Matt (Runtime): After flip: kernel fallback logs dropping. 95th latency down ~45% in the last 90s. Still some residual tail.

product_ops: Customer impact note: two customers (acme-ads, bluefin-analytics) reported 5-10s responses for embedding endpoints; CS has been notified and is sending temporary guidance.

Emily (oncall): Handoff plan: I'll stay on for next 10m to confirm stability, then hand to Matt for mitigation/rollback decision if it regresses.

Jordan (SRE): If we don't see stabilization by T+10m, prep rollback commands: `/deploy rollback rdo_6270001 --force --region us-west-2` and have release on standby.

Matt (Runtime): Running quick health checks: `tail -n 150 /var/log/runtime/kernel_select.log | grep fallback | tail -n 20` -> few entries at T-3m, now 0 in last 60s. Also rebalancing microbatch workers.

Emily (oncall): 10m check-in: metrics trending back to baseline. 95th still slightly elevated but stable. Holding canary at 20% for 30m. No rollback for now.

Jordan (SRE): Creating INC-627000 for follow-up postmortem. Suspect interaction between selector heuristic change in new_selector_v2 and adaptive-batching config leading to kernel mismatch/evictions.

Alex (Releases): We'll open a revert PR for the selector change as a backup, but hold on merging until triage. Good triage notes please (which models, node SKUs, sequence lengths observed).

product_ops: Noted. I'll collate customer reports and severity for the incident report. CS to follow up with affected accounts.

Emily (oncall): Closing immediate pager — moving to monitoring/ops. Handoff to Matt for continued mitigation and rollback readiness. Emily out in 10. 

Matt (Runtime): Acknowledged. Will keep a watch window and escalate if tail spikes again.

Jordan (SRE): Thanks team — updating incident channel and will attach logs + sampling traces to INC-627000.
